svg.title: What moves during a split: clustered vs secondary leaf
svg.desc: A clustered index (PK) leaf holds the whole row (id, name, email, address, bio, created_at, ...), about 800 B, so roughly 20 rows fit per 16 KB page. A secondary index (email) leaf holds just (email, PK), for example "adam@x.com" pointing to 4471, about 40 bytes, so roughly 400 entries fit per 16 KB page.
